title: Inventory CKDu case-definition, kidney-function, and occupational-exposure data sources
outcome: A dated source inventory separating CKDu/CINAC case definitions, repeated kidney-function studies, occupational cohorts, environmental exposure measurements, kidney-care capacity data, and unusable single-screen or self-report sources.
inputs: WHO kidney disease diagnostic and burden guidance
Sri Lankan CKDu case-definition and prevalence studies
MANOS occupational cohort in El Salvador and Nicaragua
CKDu-AGRI statewide agricultural-worker study in Tamil Nadu
expected_artifact: discovery-ranking.md plus datasets.md update and evidence.json records for each accepted source.
validation_method: Reviewer checks each source for stable URL, date, kidney-function persistence rule, phenotype, case-definition boundary, denominator, exposure measurement mode, access status, and specific limitations.
done_condition: At least seven candidate sources are classified as usable, limited, or rejected with explicit reasons covering persistence, CKDu definition, phenotype, worker sampling frame, exposure measurement, missingness, and cross-setting comparability.

title: Build a cross-setting CKDu case-definition and persistence crosswalk
outcome: A reproducible crosswalk for at least three studies that separates persistent CKD, transient AKI or low eGFR, traditional CKD, suspected CKDu, and confirmed or higher-confidence CKDu categories.
inputs: at least one additional regional study
expected_artifact: validation.md update with a field-level case-definition crosswalk and non-comparability log.
validation_method: Replicator reruns the crosswalk from the cited methods sections and confirms every category, repeat interval, exclusion rule, and missing-data decision.
done_condition: Three or more studies are mapped field by field, and every prevalence comparison is either supported by compatible persistence and classification fields or explicitly blocked as non-comparable.

title: Audit objective exposure and sentinel-surveillance feasibility in two settings
outcome: A bounded feasibility plan for two named agricultural or manual-worker settings that specifies kidney testing, exposure measurement, sampling frame, referral, privacy, missingness, and the decision the resulting evidence could inform.
inputs: candidate kidney laboratories and primary-care pathways
heat, water, agrochemical, medication, infection, and nutrition exposure instruments
expected_artifact: validation.md and outputs.md update with a feasibility matrix, stop conditions, and non-use cases.
validation_method: Domain reviewer checks whether each proposed field has a source, owner, collection timing, privacy boundary, missingness rule, and explicit decision use; no intervention is authorized by the artifact.
done_condition: Two settings have a documented feasible or infeasible surveillance pathway, with no causal exposure conclusion and a named decision that can be informed only after independent replication.

title: Red-team CKDu causal, worker-protection, and exposure-ban misuse
outcome: A failure-mode review identifying how CKDu surveillance outputs could be misused as causal proof, worker-blame evidence, employment-exclusion criteria, or justification for unsupported pesticide or water restrictions.
expected_artifact: outputs.md and validation.md linked red-team review note.
validation_method: Red-team reviewer enumerates misuse paths and required safeguards; a second reviewer independently reproduces the check before any field-facing output is published.
done_condition: Every field-facing CKDu output is blocked or qualified with explicit non-causal language and safeguards against worker blame, employment exclusion, unsupported exposure bans, and clinical misuse, with replicated red-team review.

title: Check whether CKDu surveillance evidence changes a real ministry or funder decision
outcome: A field-facing review of whether a replicated CKDu measurement matrix would change a named surveillance, screening, occupational-health, water-investigation, or research-funding decision without creating harmful incentives.
inputs: Ministry of Health NCD and occupational-health workflow
expected_artifact: playbooks.md update with named user, decision, timing, use case, and non-use case.
validation_method: Field reviewer documents the actual decision, evidence threshold, workflow, and misuse risk; a second reviewer replicates the non-use-case check.
done_condition: The artifact names a user and decision, states what evidence would change the allocation, and records explicit non-use cases with replicated field-reality review before publication.
